card.name: Words right before threat or danger
card.fires_on: Small linking words and modifiers just before a predicted word like threat, danger or enemy, in security and risk talk. Examples are no, to, of, against, a, common.

modes.label: Linking words before threat
modes.description: A preposition or article that leads into a threat or danger noun.
modes.example: to respond<< to>> rapidly developing threats from North Korea.

modes.label: Defend against
modes.description: The word against after defend or security, where an attack or hazard comes next.
modes.example: is to defend the States<< against>> Invasions.

modes.label: Quantifier or modifier
modes.description: A word like no, a, or common right before danger, threat or enemy.
modes.example: what to do with him when there is<< no>> danger.”

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict threat and danger words next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a likely word like threat or danger.
